purpose: Provide a deterministic persistent continuity shell for an external authorized runner without claiming that the runner is already live.
hard_invariants: P_base and formal authority are read-only to this runtime candidate.
real_5min_runtime_live remains false until real authorized always-on execution evidence and formal promotion exist.
No per-pulse durable log; durable state and evidence remain bounded.
Interruption SLA timestamps are registered at observation time through observe_interruption; step() accepts no caller-supplied historical interruption timestamp.
Runtime self-observation cannot be used as external five-minute SLA evidence.
Recovery is two-stage: prepare_recovery then mark_recovery_verified.
mark_recovery_verified requires a non-self verifier identity and an explicit verification evidence reference.
A recovery attempt is not a verified recovery.
Scheduled task last_run is not durable progress.
New runtime failure rolls back only this candidate delta and never invalidates Step001-009 verified baseline without exact regression evidence.
evidence_required_for_real_live: An authorized external runner actually invokes the runtime at sub-hour cadence.
Observed 300-second heartbeat cadence with durable trusted timestamps.
At least one real interruption is registered when observed, not backfilled after recovery.
A recovery attempt occurs within 300 seconds of that trusted observation.
Recovery is independently verified with a durable evidence reference, not self-declared by the runtime.
20-minute work-lifecycle continuity shows durable progress or an explicit bounded recovery path.
Restart/outage recovers from persisted cursor/state without Experience contamination.
C verifier binds exact current artifacts and evidence before any live promotion.
phase0_acceptance: runtime self-observation is rejected as SLA evidence
W02/W03/W04 adversarial reviews have no unreleased veto
incident replay includes the 2026-08-17 W01 midstream-window recovery incident
forbidden_claims: Scheduled Tasks equals a real five-minute runner
Backfilled interruption timestamps count as five-minute SLA evidence
Runtime self-verification counts as independent recovery verification
